steps.title: This is your learning tablet.
steps.lede: StoryLab Voice turns one tablet into a library, a tutor, and a science lab.
steps.text: It works without internet, without a lab, and without an account. Everything you finish is saved on this tablet.
points: Three ways to learn: stories, a voice tutor, and virtual experiments.
Every screen can be read aloud.
Your progress stays on this device.
steps.cue: This is your learning tablet. Everything you need is already on it.

steps.title: Talk, or tap.
steps.lede: Press SPEAK to use the microphone. The bars show what the tutor is doing.
steps.text: Amber means it is speaking. Green means it is listening. If the room is loud, move closer and try again.
points: Use a normal voice, not a shout.
You can always tap an answer instead.
steps.note: Voice is quick. Touching always works.
steps.cue: Press SPEAK, wait for green, then talk. You can always tap instead.

steps.title: Stories. A tutor. A lab.
steps.lede: Each one teaches differently, and all of them save to the same progress page.
steps.text: Stories ask you questions as they go. The voice tutor answers whatever you ask. The virtual lab lets you run experiments safely on screen.
steps.note: Not sure where to start? Pick a story.
steps.cue: Three ways to learn: stories, a voice tutor, and a virtual lab.

steps.title: Your work stays yours.
steps.lede: Progress is saved on this tablet. You do not need an account to learn.
steps.text: When the tablet finds internet, saved records are uploaded. Without internet nothing is lost — they simply wait.
points: Open PROGRESS to see what you finished.
Close the session before the next student uses the tablet.
A teacher can print or export the record.
steps.note: Learning works with or without internet.
steps.cue: Your progress is saved on this tablet and uploads when internet returns.

steps.title: One question before you start.
steps.lede: There is no time limit. Choose the answer that matches this tablet.
steps.question: Which button turns on the microphone so you can talk to the tutor?

options.label: The amber SPEAK button
options.feedback: Correct. Press SPEAK, wait for the green bars, then talk.

options.label: The PROGRESS tab
options.feedback: PROGRESS shows your saved work. The microphone is on the SPEAK button.

options.label: The slots on the side
options.feedback: Those are just vents. Look for the amber SPEAK button.

steps.cue: One question. Which button turns on the microphone?
